name: Power/ground trace adequacy
description: Advisory (needs routed trace widths): a power/ground rail routed narrower than the board's median signal trace is a current + IR-drop bottleneck. A relative test (no absolute rule): the net's median routed width is compared to the median signal width, so a board that widths power correctly passes. Median (not min) avoids tripping on a single pad-entry neck. Not_applicable without routed widths and a signal baseline.
what_it_measures: Count of power/ground nets whose median routed width is below the median signal width.
